Seamless 360 degree cylindrical panorama strip, a skybox backdrop for a stylised video game with the stylised realism of a modern Nintendo golf game: believable light and atmosphere, bold saturated colour, slightly painterly. A perfectly straight level horizon line runs across the whole image at one fifth of the height from the bottom edge. Below the horizon only a hazy red desert plain. Above it golden hour over canyon country: a sky running from warm apricot at the horizon to clear turquoise above, long streaks of salmon and gold cloud, the low sun in the left third a little above the horizon, glowing. All the way round the horizon stand layered red sandstone mesas, buttes and canyon rims fading into warm haze, far and small, none taller than one eighth of the image height. No foreground objects, no people, no animals, no text, no logos, no real landmarks, no lens flare streaks, no vignette, no frame. The left edge and the right edge match exactly so the strip wraps around seamlessly.
